A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EducationQ study. Their text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F are readable and support reliable comparison despite pagination and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 14 teacher models, student-model ablations, dialogue analyses, and human evaluation of 50 dialogue pairs, with detailed results and cases in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original model evaluations, ablations, statistical analyses, human evaluation, and appendix case-study outcomes.

M1.justification: The teacher–student–evaluator framework, information-access restrictions, pre-test/dialogue/post-test procedure, and substantive agent prompts remain unchanged. Revised agent descriptions clarify the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro Stratified across the same disciplines and difficulty coverage, and use GPQA-main for stability testing. No datasets, populations, or teaching scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 and Appendix E retain the same compared models, including all 14 teachers in Table 4. The added related-work citations do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: Sampling, metrics, five-round interactions, and the human-evaluation protocol are retained. Section 4.9 changes '150 tokens per dialogue round' to 'per turn'; Appendices A.1.1 and A.2.1 already specify separate 150-token response recommendations in v1, supporting clarification rather than a changed budget.

E4.justification: The student-model ablation, token/round sensitivity findings, cross-dataset consistency checks, difficulty and unique-improvement analyses, and Appendix F case studies retain the same evidence.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains the same two-run stability study and variance reporting. Correlations, significance reporting, regression analyses, and human-agreement estimation practices are unchanged; no additional runs or uncertainty procedures are documented.

E6.justification: Section 7.5 corrects Gemini 1.5 Pro 002's PNIR from 75 to 0.40, matching Table 4 in both PDFs. The matched experimental tables and appendix outcomes otherwise remain unchanged; this corrects reporting rather than demonstrating improved performance.

T1.justification: The ALG, PNIR, CSS, and UIC definitions and Equations 1–4 are unchanged. Expanded background discussion introduces no new mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the central claims about EducationQ, the mismatch between model scale and teaching effectiveness, and the need for specialized pedagogical optimization. The contribution bullet is rephrased without substantively changing the claimed capability.

C2.justification: The Limitations section replaces the warning that primary metrics miss capability diversity and evaluator findings require further validation with discussion of predefined qualitative dimensions and a possible composite teaching score. It emphasizes the existing 78% human agreement and softens the explicit validation caveat.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3.4 removes the explicit note that formatted evaluator inputs include 'Teacher:' and 'Student:' turns, slightly reducing input-format documentation. The substantive prompts, hyperparameters, retry mechanisms, model specifications, and code-access information remain.

R1.justification: v2 adds Miao et al. (2021) in the introduction and Park et al. (2023), Kojima et al. (2022), and Weng et al. (2023) alongside expanded student-modeling background in Section 2.3. This modestly broadens contextual grounding without redefining the research contribution.

P1.justification: Localized revisions tighten the introduction, related work, agent descriptions, limitations, and appendix explanations. Terminology and punctuation receive small edits, while a new 'fudamental' typo appears in the conclusion. The section and appendix sequence remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 corrects 'Trun' to 'Turn'. Table 7 changes from a full-width display to a compact column table, allowing Appendices C–E to share a page. Captions, spacing, and pagination receive limited changes; all figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting the PNIR text/table inconsistency provides a concrete gain in reporting accuracy, accompanied by modest improvements in wording and background context. The net gain is limited: empirical support is unchanged, some documentation is trimmed, and the revised limitations soften the earlier call for further validation.
